_comment: Every dataset the build uses, pinned to an exact git commit. `atlas fetch` checks out only the listed files and records their SHA-256 in data/raw/manifest.lock.json; `atlas build` refuses to run if a file no longer matches its recorded hash. Change a commit here to upgrade a source; the build output records which commits it came from.

sources.title: OpenBible.info Cross References
sources.provides: About 340,000 verse-to-verse cross-references with community vote weights (derived from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge and user votes).
sources.attribution: Cross references from OpenBible.info, CC BY 4.0
sources.note: openbible.info publishes the file directly; this build reads the unmodified copy mirrored in scrollmapper/bible_databases so the input is pinned by git commit.

sources.title: Berean Standard Bible (BSB)
sources.provides: English text of all 66 books. Used for search, the word-to-word links, and as the default reading text.
sources.attribution: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB is produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.com, and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. This text of God's Word has been dedicated to the public domain.

sources.provides: Every Hebrew and Aramaic word of the Old Testament (Leningrad Codex), with transliteration, contextual English, Strong's root and grammar.

sources.title: Clear Bible BSB word alignments
sources.provides: Hand-made links from each Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek word to the BSB English words that translate it (Hebrew from the WLC as tokenized by Macula, Greek from the Berean Greek New Testament). Used to color matching words in word-by-word mode.
